import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from extract_idb import dump_table
from collections import Counter
recs = dump_table('https_lgbtqspace.org_0.indexeddb.leveldb/000020.ldb')
paths = Counter(); worlds = Counter()
for k,v in recs:
    a = k.replace(b'\x00',b'')
    i = a.find(b'worlds/')
    if i >= 0:
        j = a.find(b'\x01', i)
        p = a[i:j].decode('ascii', 'replace')
        paths[p] = len(v)
        worlds[p.split('/')[1]] += 1
    else:
        # non-world record: show ascii-ish
        t = bytes(b for b in a if 32 <= b < 127)
        if len(t) > 4: paths['META:'+t[:100].decode()] += 1
print('worlds:', dict(worlds))
print('total file records:', sum(worlds.values()))
import re
suf = Counter()
for p in paths:
    if p.startswith('worlds/'):
        rest = p.split('/',2)[2]
        suf[rest[:24] if len(rest)>24 else rest] += 1
for s,c in sorted(suf.items()): print(c, s)
"","description":"List worlds and file layout in store","yield_time_ms":180000}

{"command":"& "$env:LocalAppData\Python\bin\python.exe" -c "
import sys, gzip; sys.path.insert(1,'.')
from extract_idb import dump_table
def getvarint(d,p):
    r=s=0
    while True:
        b=d[p];p+=1;r|=(b&127)<<s
        if not b&128: return r,p
        s+=7
recs = dump_table('https_lgbtqspace.org_0.indexeddb.leveldb/000020.ldb')
files = {}
for k,v in recs:
    a = k.replace(b'\x00',b'')
    i = a.find(b'worlds/')
    if i < 0: continue
    j = a.find(b'\x01', i)
    p = a[i:j].decode('ascii')
    m = v.find(b'\"data\"B')
    if m < 0: continue
    ln,pp = getvarint(v, m+7)
    files[p] = v[pp:pp+ln]
print('extracted files:', len(files))
import collections
loc = collections.Counter()
for p in files:
    parts = p.split('/')
    loc[parts[2] if len(parts)>2 else parts[1]] += 1
print(dict(loc))
top = sorted([p for p in files if p.count('/')==2])
print('top-level:', top[:20])
# decompress level.dat head
raw = gzip.decompress(files['worlds/16_Survival_Map/level.dat'])
print('level.dat ungzipped:', len(raw), raw[:60])
# one chunk
ck = sorted([p for p in files if '/level0/' in p])[0]
raw2 = gzip.decompress(files[ck])
print('chunk', ck.split('/')[-1], 'ungzipped:', len(raw2), raw2[:80])
import pickle
pickle.dump(files, open('C:/Users/danie/OneDrive/Documents/usb-drive-data/brave mc world/world_files.pkl','wb'))
print('saved pickle, total bytes:', sum(map(len, files.values())))
"","description":"Extract payloads, verify NBT, cache to pickle","yield_time_ms":180000}
